The '''Haunch of Nerf''' was a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] located in the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant University]] quarter on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="O66" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] was designed to appear rustic, and evoke an archaic sense of the working-class past. The alleyway entrance to the Haunch of [[Nerf/Legends|Nerf]] was constructed in a mock-ancient style, reminiscent of a [[Baron/Legends|baronial]] [[Fortress/Legends|fort]]. The interior of the restaurant was hot, intentionally rough-hewn, and full of inaccurately designed replicas of antique rural feasting trestles. [[Foodstuff/Legends|Food]] at the Haunch of Nerf was served on [[pleekwood]] trenchers instead of more contemporary porceplast plates, and the cantina's [[Ale/Legends|ale]] was brewed specially to retain a cloudy appearance full of unidentifiable lumps, thought to be authentic to the ancient aesthetic the Haunch of Nerf aspired to. The Haunch of Nerf typically attracted upper class clientele, and offered private tables away from the main salon.<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Coruscant [[University/Legends|University]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] of [[Biologist/Legends|biology]], [[Reye Nenilin]], met with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Kal Skirata]] at the Haunch of Nerf. The two shared a private table with Skirata's colleagues, Mandalorian [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Mij Gilamar]] and the undercover [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null-class]] [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Mereel Skirata|Mereel]], while discussing [[Gene/Legends|genetics]] research. Skirata attempted to covertly enlist Nenilin's aid in halting the accelerating aging that afflicted the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Republic army's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], eventually convincing the professor to look over the data he had gathered. Skirata thought little of the Haunch of Nerf's false sense of archaism and the patrons' inaccurate, romanticized ideals of how the working-class common [[Gender/Legends|man]] lived in the past. While he was leaving the cantina, he scoffed at the Haunch of Nerf's mock-ancient exterior, musing that it was likely little more than a year old despite its historical design.<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Haunch of Nerf first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the fourth entry in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]] of novels, [[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel|''Order 66'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[September 16]], [[2008]].
